title: Correct external force F
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) is 1.5 N.

title: Correct length L
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) is 0.5 m.

title: Correct Joule heat Q
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) is 0.4 J.

title: Force balance analysis
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law correctly during the acceleration phase, accounting for applied force, friction, gravity component, and magnetic force.

title: Motional EMF and current
description: Important: Correctly uses E = BLv and I = E/R to find the induced current during uniform motion.

title: Graph interpretation
description: Important: Identifies the constant velocity (2.0 m/s) from the graph and uses it in calculations.

title: Time in field calculation
description: Optional: Correctly calculates the time the loop spends entering/leaving the field using t = ef / v.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns the direction of the magnetic force or friction, leading to a wrong force balance.

title: Unit inconsistency
description: Pitfall: Fails to use consistent SI units (e.g., for B, m, g) in calculations.
